# Caputo's Market & Deli

> > Specialty food market and deli in Salt Lake City featuring artisan craft chocolate, gourmet tinned fish, cocktail ingredients, and curated culinary products from Utah and around the world.

Caputo's is a premier specialty food retailer in Utah, known for its extensive selection of bean-to-bar craft chocolate, Italian conservas, and small-batch cocktail bitters and syrups. The market also hosts culinary classes and tasting events featuring wine, whiskey, and regional Italian cuisine.

## Key Topics

- craft chocolate
- bean-to-bar chocolate
- Utah chocolate makers
- artisan chocolate
- specialty foods
- cocktail bitters
- bar ingredients
- tinned fish & conservas
- Italian cuisine
- Salt Lake City

- wine tasting
- local producers
- gourmet products
- small-batch ingredients

## Utah Craft Chocolate

- [Utah Chocolate Producers](https://caputos.com/utah-chocolate): Utah craft chocolate makers from Salt Lake City, Park City & Provo
- [The Cacao Bean Project](https://caputos.com/cacao-bean-project): Local artisan chocolate producer from Sandy, Utah near Wasatch mountains

## International Craft Chocolate

- [Alchemy by To'ak](https://caputos.com/alchemy-by-toak): Luxury Ecuadorian heirloom cacao chocolate with Amazonian ingredients
- [Harper Macaw](https://caputos.com/harper-macaw): Brazilian single-origin craft chocolate from Atlantic & Amazon rainforests
- [Marou](https://caputos.com/marou): Vietnamese single-origin dark chocolate from Ho Chi Minh City & Ben Tre

## Cocktail Ingredients & Bitters

- [Small Hand Foods](https://caputos.com/small-hand-foods): Oakland-based craft cocktail syrups & bar ingredients by Jennifer Colliau
- [Dr Adam Elmegirab's Bitters](https://caputos.com/dr-adam-elmegirabs): Scottish craft cocktail bitters including historic Boker's Bitters revival
- [Luxardo](https://caputos.com/luxardo): Italian Luxardo Maraschino Cherries & cocktail ingredients from Veneto

## Gourmet Specialty Foods

- [José Gourmet](https://caputos.com/jose-gourmet): Portuguese gourmet tinned fish & conservas from Lisbon
